subject: RFQ: 50pcs hydraulic cylinder bore 50mm stroke 200mm
body:
Hi team,

We need a quotation for hydraulic cylinders with the following spec:
- Bore: 50mm
- Stroke: 200mm
- Working pressure: 16MPa
- Mounting: front flange
- Quantity: 50 pieces, possible ramp to 200/quarter

Delivery to Chicago by sea. Please advise FOB price, lead time, and payment terms (we usually do 30% TT deposit + 70% against BL copy).

Thanks,
Mike Donovan
Purchasing Manager

subject: Urgent: 10000pcs 6205-2RS bearings — repeat order
body:
Dear Sales,

Urgent repeat order — our line stops on Friday if we don't have stock confirmed.

6205-2RS deep groove ball bearings, 10,000 pieces, GCr15 chrome steel, 2RS rubber seal. Same spec as last 6 shipments.

Need:
1. Confirmed availability today
2. Best repeat-customer price (last PO was $1.78/pc)
3. Earliest dispatch date

Mumbai port, CIF.

Regards,
Rajesh Kumar

subject: Запрос: шаровые краны DN50 нержавеющая сталь

body:

subject: Technical query: spherical roller bearing 22210EK availability
body:
Hello,

We are designing a new textile machine and need spherical roller bearings 22210EK with taper bore 1:12. Could you confirm:

1. Do you stock GCr15 material? Some suppliers offer cheaper carbon steel which we cannot use.
2. ISO P5 or P6 precision class?
3. Quantity 30 pieces for prototype, then potential 500/year if approved.

Karachi port. Please share TDS if available.

Best,
Muhammad Asif
Design Engineer

subject: Прайс-лист и условия сотрудничества
body:
Добрый день,

Мы видели вашу компанию на выставке в Минске. Интересует широкий ассортимент: подшипники, крепеж, гидравлика. Можете ли вы прислать общий прайс-лист и условия для нового дилера?

В первую очередь интересуют:
- Подшипники 6205, 6206 серии
- Болты M8, M10, M12

С уважением,
Андрей Соколов

subject: RFQ: válvulas de bola DN25 SS304
body:

Gracias,
Carmen Ruiz

subject: Quote needed: gate valves DN80 PN10 ductile iron
body:
We need 80 pieces of cast iron gate valves DN80 PN10, flanged ends, ductile iron GGG40 body. Application: fire-water network at offshore platform support.

API 6D certification preferred. Please quote FOB Tianjin and lead time. Payment LC at sight.

Thanks,
Ahmed Al-Mansoori
Sourcing Lead

body:

Cheers,
Dave Williams
